sets.relationshipLabel: object and the structural feature it has
sets.explanation: An orb web's hub and a leaf's vein are both the central, branching feature that gives the object its structure, not something it does or becomes.

sets.relationshipLabel: organ and the action it exists to perform
sets.explanation: A spinneret exists to spin silk and a fang exists to inject venom — each organ is defined by the single act it was built for.

sets.relationshipLabel: one thing transforming into another through a process
sets.explanation: Mist condenses into dew and a grub metamorphoses into a beetle — two very different domains, same shape of transformation.

sets.relationshipLabel: start and end of a span
sets.explanation: Sunrise opens a day as sunset closes it, and weaving begins a fabric's life as tearing ends it — the same start-to-finish shape at wildly different scales.
